# Support

How to get help with AIOS.

This project does **not** promise response times or service-level commitments. Maintainers respond as capacity allows.

**Do not include credentials, tokens, secrets, or personal data in public reports.**

---

## Where to go

| Need | Direction |
|------|-----------|
| General usage questions | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/fdeniz07/AIOS/issues) |
| Bug reports | [Bug Report](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md) issue template |
| Documentation problems | [Documentation](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/documentation.md) issue template |
| Feature proposals | [Feature Request](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md) issue template |
| Contribution guidance | [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Security vulnerabilities | [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) |

---

## Security reports

Do **not** publish vulnerability details in public Issues.

Follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) for private or coordinated disclosure.

---

## Before opening an issue

1. Check existing Issues for duplicates.
2. Prefer a clear title and the matching template.
3. Include only the information needed to understand or reproduce the request.
